messages:
maria-ops: Heads up, since ~02:13 UTC we're seeing a repeating ~25-40s 'sawtooth' of packet loss between gpu-pool pods in eastus. Model batching latency spikes for 1-2s windows. Looks like overlay encap issues but not sure.

ajay-sre: Got the alert. Can you paste node dmesg, pod logs, and run a quick `tcpdump -nni any 'udp and port 8472'` on an affected node to capture encapsulated Geneve/VXLAN?

maria-ops: Paste below. tcpdump (trimmed):
```
14:13:09.123456 IP 10.2.1.45.51880 > 10.2.3.22.8472: UDP, length 1400
14:13:09.123789 IP 10.2.1.45.51880 > 10.2.3.22.8472: UDP, length 1400
14:13:10.124012 IP 10.2.1.45.51880 > 10.2.3.22.8472: UDP, length 580
```
and dmesg snippet: `mlx5_core 0000:af:00.0: GSO: skb_cow fail, len 4096` repeated.

linh-net: Those outer lengths show encapsulated packets near MTU boundary. What CNI and what's `ip link show` for the tunnel? Could be geneve mtu mismatch or offload interaction.

maria-ops: CNI is red-tunnel (our Geneve variant). `ip link show geneve0` shows MTU 1450 on nodes in rack-b.

ajay-sre: Underlay is jumbo (9000). Why would geneve be 1450 on some nodes? Check `ethtool -k ens1f0` and `/proc/cmdline` for kubelet flags. Also `sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing`.

samir-mlinfra: From model side we see gRPC timeouts `DeadlineExceeded` and batching timers jump. Correlates exactly with the sawtooth windows.

carol-oncall: conntrack spikes during the windows, then drops. Looks like retransmit bursts. If encapsulation causes fragmentation and GSO fails, we could get conntrack churn.

linh-net: Two quick hypotheses: 1) MTU mismatch across nodes -> IP fragmentation of outer UDP -> NIC/GSO path can't handle larger skbs -> skb_cow -> drops. 2) NIC offload/firmware bug on mlx5 when handling many medium-size UDP encap packets (GSO/GRO path). Both plausible.

ajay-sre: Repro steps for infra: on nodeA/nodeB run `iperf3 -u -c <peer> -b 0 -l 1400 -t 60` between pod IPs; run tcpdump for encap; capture `ethtool -k ens1f0`; `cat /sys/class/net/geneve0/mtu`.

maria-ops: Ran iperf3 UDP: throughput oscillates and loss lines up with sawtooth windows. iperf output excerpt:
```
[  4]  0.00-1.00   sec  1.23 MBytes  10.3 Mbits/sec  0.0% loss
[  4]  1.00-2.00   sec  0.12 MBytes  1.00 Mbits/sec   20.5% loss
[  4]  2.00-3.00   sec  1.28 MBytes  10.7 Mbits/sec  0.0% loss
```

linh-net: As a quick mitigation, disable GSO/GRO/LRO on the host NIC: `ethtool -K ens1f0 gso off gro off lro off` and try `ip link set geneve0 mtu 8950` to match underlay minus encap overhead. If GSO bug, turning off offload should stop skb_cow.

maria-ops: Did both on node-a and node-b. Results: disabling GSO removed the repeated `skb_cow` dmesg lines. Raising geneve0 MTU to 8950 removed outer-fragment traces from tcpdump. Latency spikes reduced significantly.

samir-mlinfra: After mitigation, gRPC timeouts dropped from ~4/min to ~1/min. Performance improved for in-flight model batches.

carol-oncall: Good short-term win. Action items we should track as P1 for root cause:
- eng-infra: open vendor SR with Mellanox/driver team for mlx5 GSO failure; attach dmesg, ethtool-k, pcap and iperf logs.
- net: audit CNI MTU propagation (kubelet/ds/daemonset init) to understand how some nodes ended up with MTU 1450.
- infra: plan canary to disable offloads across the gpu-pool if vendor response slow.

ajay-sre: I'll file the SR. @maria-ops please upload the pcap + full kubelet flags and tag me. Also include kernel version and driver (`modinfo mlx5_core`).

maria-ops: Uploaded pcap and kubelet args to the ticket. Found a preflight script in rack-b that sets geneve mtu 1450 for legacy compat (leftover). We'll remove that and make reconciler assert MTU = underlay - encap.

linh-net: Long-term: CNI reconciler should compute and enforce MTU per-node (underlay_mtu - encap_overhead), and console should alert when mismatch detected. Also consider a cluster health alert on repeated `skb_cow` dmesg patterns.

samir-mlinfra: Also rolling a small client-side retry/backoff change to model-serving to tolerate short 1-2s windows would reduce user impact while infra fixes land.

carol-oncall: I'll coordinate a short maintenance tonight to roll the mitigation to the pool and remove the preflight setting. deploy-bot scheduled the window.

deploy-bot: scheduled: maintenance window for gpu-pool-eastus 2026-03-21T02:00Z -> 02:20Z

maria-ops: Thanks, will monitor post-maintain and update vendor SR when they ack. Closing loop here for now :thumbsup:
